# BTicino C300X Integration v1.9.6

## Unreleased

## Added

- Groundwork for device-side uncompressed audio (PCMU): the agent can now raise
  the media daemon's on-demand teardown drain. Without it, uncompressed audio
  makes the device reboot a few seconds after an on-demand stream is closed. The
  patch is applied in place, size-preserving, hash-verified per range, backed up
  before the first write and reversible.
- The codec switch is coupled to that patch and refuses to enable the codec
  unless it is in place, so the reboot condition cannot be re-introduced by
  enabling the codec alone.
- A device already running the device codec from an earlier release gets the
  patch backfilled on agent start, without rewriting anything once it is in
  place.

## Changed

- The device binary patchers share their range-patch mechanics instead of
  duplicating them.
